name: Silverio Ragnarok
original_name: シルヴァリオ ラグナロク
source:
"Silverio Ragnarok" is the third and final installment of the "Silverio Saga" series.
The fierce battles between cool superhumans and beautiful battles between fascinating characters have captured the hearts of many fans to date.
This is a story of fate, demise, and hope as the "Godslayer Ragna" and his partner "Hikari" fight to the death to overthrow the gods who rule the people with their overwhelming power.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292950/]Steam[/url]]
